professionalSummary.text: Led the packaging-consumables consolidation at Tolland Foods, issuing RFQs to 14 suppliers, building price and lead-time comparisons, and drafting the award paper for the sourcing board.

The subjective claim about being 'the driving force' and 'single-handedly reshaping' the supply base is not supported by the evidence and requires verification.
